_comment_live_enabled: Master switch for the live-match feature set (live.wendovercc.org poller, live-match slides, live-aware today slide, ticker + news-flash overlays). Off = none of it is built or polled, so other changes can ship without turning on this unfinished work.
_comment_league_abbr: Short forms for the live chrome's gold flag, which is one band wide (~138px) and has no room for a full league name. Keyed by Play-Cricket's league_name, exact match. A league with no entry here falls back to its division alone, so an unmapped league is untidy, never broken. Keep these to ~4 characters and to what people actually say at the club.
_comment_live_poll_lead_minutes: How long before the day's first start the live poll window opens (live-config.json poll_from) — scorers open a match and settle the toss before the first ball. The window always shuts at midnight, which is also the safeguard if the nightly build fails: a stale config's window has already closed. Outside the window no device touches live.wendovercc.org.
_comment_last_match_max_age_days: How long a team's last-match PACKAGE (intro → scorecards → reels → result) stays in the decks, counted from the match date. Long enough to cover the following weekend, so Saturday's game is still the full story for a Sunday friendly, and it lapses before the next fixture replaces it anyway. In practice it only bites teams that have STOPPED playing (juniors at season's end). When the package lapses the team's standalone last-match-result card takes over automatically — see build_slideshows.
_comment_leaderboards: Best-average qualification: min_innings / min_overs is the bar, relaxed back towards floor_innings / floor_overs only where it would leave a table short of rows (early season, thin squads, small junior scopes).
_comment_recurring_events: Standing entries in the context calendar that no feed knows about — hardcoded until ClubSports365 exposes bar opening times, at which point this becomes a fetch. Each generates a calendar entry on every matching weekday from `from` (inclusive) for the next few months. Lowest priority of any activity, so a match or a training session at the same ground still wins its window.
